prompt: From 1st January 2015 to 5th February 2019, how many hectares of forest land were diverted in Goa for non-forestry purposes under the Forest Conservation Act of 1980 (MoEF&CC, 2019)?
answer: From **1 January 2015 to 5 February 2019**, approximately **24.82 hectares** of forest land in **Goa** were diverted for non-forestry purposes under the **Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980**, according to MoEF&CC (2019).
